description: This file contains implementation of a command execution utility for running shell commands, capturing output, and handling their exit codes, with logging and error handling.

methods.name: bool os_cmd_exec_xv(char ** buffer,int * len,int * exit_code,int flags,char * fmt,va_list args)
methods.description: Executes a command with formatted arguments, captures its output, logs output lines, manages output buffer, and handles the exit code with customizable flags.

methods.name: bool os_cmd_exec_x(char ** buffer,int * len,int * exit_code,int flags,char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Wrapper around os_cmd_exec_xv that provides variadic argument support.

methods.name: bool os_cmd_exec(char ** buffer,char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Simpler interface to execute a command with formatted string, capturing output.
